method: 逐段核对英文原文、对应中文及已解码音轨的下一词开口。分句间有停顿时在停顿中点切换；连续语流在下一词附近的低能量点切换。

cuts.en: forward-facing eyes, a large grey beak, large blue feet, and relatively short wings and tail.
cuts.zh: 它双眼朝前，喙大而灰，两脚硕大、呈蓝色，翅膀和尾巴相对较短。

cuts.en: and is also possibly one of the world’s longest-living birds, with a reported lifespan of up to 100 years.
cuts.zh: 也可能是世界上最长寿的鸟类之一，据报道寿命可达100年。

cuts.en: but at best manage a controlled descent to the ground.
cuts.zh: 但最多也只能控制着身体降落到地面。

cuts.en: as well as bulbs, and fern fronds.
cuts.zh: 也包括植物的鳞茎和蕨叶。

cuts.en: females alone incubate eggs and feed the chicks.
cuts.zh: 孵卵和给雏鸟喂食全由雌鸟负责。

cuts.en: which leaves the unattended eggs and chicks particularly vulnerable to predators.
cuts.zh: 这使无人照看的鸟卵和雏鸟尤其容易遭到捕食。

cuts.en: kākāpō had become confined to the central North Island and forested parts of the South Island.
cuts.zh: 鸮鹦鹉已只分布在北岛中部和南岛有森林覆盖的地区。

cuts.en: and introduced species such as deer depleted the remaining forests of food.
cuts.zh: 而鹿等外来物种又大量消耗了剩余森林中的食物。

cuts.en: stoats arrived within six years, eventually destroying the kākāpō population.
cuts.zh: 六年之内，白鼬就来到岛上，最终使这里的鸮鹦鹉种群覆灭。

cuts.en: to find kākāpō, focusing mainly on Fiordland.
cuts.zh: 目的是寻找鸮鹦鹉，重点在峡湾地区。

cuts.en: and all but one died within a few months of captivity.
cuts.zh: 被圈养后的几个月内，除一只外，其余五只都死了。

cuts.en: a large island free from stoats, ferrets and weasels.
cuts.zh: 这座大岛上没有白鼬、雪貂和伶鼬。

cuts.en: Codfish Island, Maud Island and Little Barrier Island.
cuts.zh: 即科德菲什岛、莫德岛和小巴里尔岛。

cuts.en: and an insufficient number of chicks survived to offset adult mortality.
cuts.zh: 而活下来的雏鸟太少，无法弥补成鸟死亡带来的数量损失。

cuts.en: together with a specialist advisory group called the Kākāpō Scientific and Technical Advisory Committee and a higher amount of funding.
cuts.zh: 同时成立了名为“鸮鹦鹉科学技术咨询委员会”的专家咨询小组，并增加了经费。

cuts.en: and possums were eradicated from Codfish Island by 1986.
cuts.zh: 到1986年，科德菲什岛上的袋貂也已被彻底清除。

cuts.en: and rescuing and hand-raising any failing chicks.
cuts.zh: 以及救助生长状况不佳的雏鸟并人工喂养。

cuts.en: and the total population had grown to 62 birds.
cuts.zh: 种群总数增至62只。

cuts.en: and by June 2020, a total of 210 birds was recorded.
cuts.zh: 到2020年6月，记录在册的鸮鹦鹉共有210只。

cuts.en: restore or maintain sufficient habitat to accommodate the expected increase in the kākāpō population,
cuts.zh: 恢复或保有充足的栖息地，以适应预期中的种群增长；

cuts.en: and ensure stakeholders continue to be fully engaged in the preservation of the species.
cuts.zh: 确保各利益相关方继续充分参与这一物种的保护。
